Complaint Details: AH’s Novo account was compromised after their phone was stolen, leading to unauthorized access to multiple financial accounts. AH repeatedly requested urgent action, including freezing the account and logging out unauthorized users. After multiple follow-ups, Novo initiated an identity verification process. AH later regained access to their original email, reset their Novo credentials, and confirmed fraudulent activity. Novo eventually updated AH’s login details, lifted the account freeze, and provided security recommendations. AH was advised to review account settings and monitor for further suspicious activity.
Brief Summary of Resolution: Solved via SOP

Complaint Details:
AH reported that his banking information was stolen and requested to create a new account. Novo initiated an identity verification process and requested AH to submit an ID Theft Verification Form, including a photo of himself holding his ID.

After multiple submissions and clarifications regarding the required image quality, AH successfully completed the verification process. Novo then updated his login credentials, unfroze his account, and advised him to reset his password. AH was also instructed to review his account settings, including email, phone number, and authorized users, to ensure no unauthorized changes had been made.
Brief Summary of Resolution: Solved via SOP
